name: incarna
description: Turn the training program you design with your AI into a real, tracked workout, and log your nutrition alongside it.

defaultPrompt: Build me a 3-day push/pull/legs split in Incarna.
Look at my recent Incarna workouts and tell me what to progress.
Set my daily nutrition target in Incarna and log what I just ate.
interface.longDescription: Incarna is the execution layer for AI-designed training and nutrition. Your assistant builds a workout (exercises, sets, supersets, rest) or a multi-week program and writes it straight into your Incarna account through this connector. You then run it for real in the Incarna app: a running timer, sets to check off, loads and pace logged. Next time you talk to your AI, it reads the history back (RPE, completed vs skipped sets, your notes) and adjusts. Your assistant can also read and set your daily nutrition target and log meals on your behalf. Works for a solo trainee and for a coach driving a linked client's workouts, programs, and nutrition.
interface.shortDescription: Turn your plan into a workout
